SELECT PROD_ID as prodId, PROD_CODE as prodCode, PROD_NAME as name, PROD_PRICE as price, BRAND as brand, IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, SOURCE as source, BOARD_TYPE as boardType, REG_DATE as regDate FROM Common_Product WHERE 1=1
AND BOARD_TYPE = 'DROP' AND BOARD_TYPE = 'HOT'
ORDER BY PROD_ID DESC OFFSET #{pageStart} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{perPageNum} ROWS ONLY

SELECT DEAL_ID AS dealId, ORIGIN_URL AS originUrl, TITLE AS title, CURRENT_PRICE AS currentPrice, MALL_NAME AS mallName, LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS lastUpdateDate, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER WHERE 1=1
AND TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND ORIGIN_URL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC OFFSET #{pageStart} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{perPageNum} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER WHERE 1=1
AND TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND ORIGIN_URL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' AND TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Common_Product WHERE 1=1
AND BOARD_TYPE = 'DROP' AND BOARD_TYPE = 'HOT'
